note.ja: 解析解 原子単位、ゼロDirichlet端点、一様内点格子。箱[0,1]とHO[-L,L]です。 1次元模型の原子単位でℏ=m=1、HOはω=1。箱[0,1]とHOの有限区間[-L,L]はいずれも同次Dirichlet。 8回の全固有対計算で824組をraw保存、規格化等の資格判定は選択24組です。節の閾値と位相は診断、HO0.003は固定例の達成目標で証明済み上界ではありません。有限壁と格子感度を相殺から独立に保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Finite Dirichlet boxes and central differences; whole-line HO formulas do not isolate finite-wall error. Node counts diagnostic until forward sign qualification. Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1. The box[0,1] and finite HO[-L,L] domains both use homogeneous Dirichlet conditions. Eight full solves save824raw pairs; qualification applies to24selected pairs. Thresholded nodes/phase are diagnostics. HO0.003 is a met fixed-case goal, not a proved bound; finite-wall/mesh sensitivities do not certify separate errors.
